_schema: Room content. The renderer's trust boundary, enforced in room.js:
_plain: PLAIN TEXT, escaped on render: cards[].name, groups[].title, groups[].symbols[].n
_raw: RAW AUTHORED HTML, injected as-is: cards[].body, cards[].note, examples[].q, examples[].steps[], examples[].ans, groups[].symbols[].g
_rule: Anything moved between those two lists changes what the browser does with it. Plain fields must never contain markup; raw fields are trusted and must never hold anything a reader typed.

cards.name: How this hub works
cards.body: Shared bench skills — safety, notebook, solution & buffer prep, pipetting, controls, calibration, troubleshooting, data quality — live here permanently. Specialized methods are introduced here, then surfaced inside their discipline area: Chemistry, Organic, Analytical, Biochemistry, Biology, Neuroscience & Ephys, and Data methods.
cards.note: One place to learn a technique; the discipline room for its specifics.

cards.name: PPE & safety mindset
cards.body: Gloves, goggles, coat; know your reagents (read the SDS); right waste stream; sharps care.
cards.note: Safety is part of reproducibility, not box-ticking.

cards.name: Pipetting accuracy
cards.body: Pre-wet tips · first stop to aspirate, second to dispense · hold vertical · no bubbles · calibrate.

cards.name: Solution prep workflow
cards.body: moles → mass (m = nM) · dissolve in < final volume · bring to volume in a volumetric flask · label.

cards.name: Buffer prep workflow
cards.body: Pick a buffer with pK<sub>a</sub> within ±1 of target · mix acid + conjugate base · adjust pH · bring to volume.
cards.note: Check final pH at the working temperature.

cards.name: pH adjustment
cards.body: Calibrate the meter (2–3 points) · add acid/base slowly while stirring · let it equilibrate · approach gradually.

cards.name: Microscopy basics
cards.body: Köhler illumination · match objective & immersion · NA sets resolution · clean optics · focus, then contrast.

cards.name: Fluorescence imaging
cards.body: Match the filter set to the fluorophore (ex/em) · minimize photobleaching & phototoxicity · set baseline F₀.

cards.name: Patch clamp workflow
cards.body: Pull & polish pipette · fill with internal · approach with positive pressure · form GΩ seal · break in → whole-cell.

cards.name: Whole-cell recording QC
cards.body: GΩ seal before break-in · stable R<sub>a</sub> · steady holding current · healthy R<sub>m</sub>.

cards.name: Rₐ / seal / holding current
cards.body: R<sub>a</sub> (series) filters fast events — compensate & track % change · GΩ seal = quality · holding-current drift = health change.

cards.name: Calcium imaging workflow
cards.body: Express GCaMP · choose baseline F₀ · ΔF/F = (F − F₀)/F₀ · correct motion & bleaching · define ROIs · threshold events.

cards.name: iGluSnFR / glutamate imaging
cards.body: Sensor reports extracellular glutamate (release) · same ΔF/F pipeline · fast kinetics — match the frame rate · ROI at the synapse.

cards.name: Protein purification
cards.body: Lyse → clarify → capture (affinity) → polish (size / ion-exchange) → concentrate. Keep it cold; add protease inhibitors.

cards.name: Chromatography
cards.body: Affinity (His-tag / Ni) · ion-exchange (charge) · size-exclusion (size). Load → wash → elute; watch A<sub>280</sub>.

cards.name: Enzyme assay setup
cards.body: Fix [enzyme], vary [substrate] · measure the initial (linear) rate · include blanks · control T & pH · fit Michaelis–Menten.

cards.name: Gel electrophoresis
cards.body: SDS-PAGE separates proteins by size; agarose for DNA. Run a ladder; stain (Coomassie / EtBr); size from migration.

cards.name: Controls & replicates
cards.body: Positive (expected signal) · negative / vehicle (no signal) · internal controls. Technical vs biological replicates — report n.

cards.name: Troubleshooting logic
cards.body: Change ONE variable · check controls & reagents first · reproduce the failure · log what you tried.

cards.name: Lab notebook standards
cards.body: Date · aim · materials & lot numbers · exact protocol & settings · observations · raw-data location · conclusion.
cards.note: Write it as you go; reproducible by a stranger.

cards.name: Data quality checklist
cards.body: Baseline stable? · SNR acceptable? · controls passed? · n adequate? · units & calibration correct? · artifacts flagged?
